findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.comment:
The following canned foods on the shelves were observed to have dents:
1. Clover valley cream style corn has dent along the seam.
2. Campbells beef barley soup has dent along the seam.
3. Armour chili no beans has significant dents in the body and along the seam (x6).
4. Clover valley fruit cocktail in light syrup has dent along the seam (x3).
5. Dole pineapple chunks has dent along the seam.

CORRECTED - The person-in-charge (PIC) was informed and the dented cans were removed from the shelf. Dented cans can have entry and harborage of Botulism, ensure canned foods with dents are removed from the shelf and not sold to customers.
findings.citation_text: 3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants. [PF]

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored and used.
findings.comment: Auto air fresheners were observed hanging over canned tomato basil soups. CORRECTED - The PIC was informed and the auto air fresheners were moved to a different location. Ensure poisonous or toxic materials are not stored over food.
findings.citation_text: 7-201.11 Separation. Poisonous or toxic materials shall be stored so they can not contaminate food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single-service and single-use articles by: (A) Separating the POISONOUS OR TOXIC MATERIALS by spacing or partitioning; and (B) Locating the POISONOUS OR TOXIC MATERIALS in an area that is not above FOOD, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE or SINGLE-USE ARTICLES. [P]

findings.title: Thermometers are provided and accurate.
findings.comment: No ambient thermometers were observed in the back storage cooler and cooler used for hot dogs and eggs. The PIC was informed and instructed to provide internal thermometers in each of the coolers to allow for proper temperature monitoring, especially in the event of equipment failure. Ensure ambient thermometers are placed in the warmest part of each of the coolers to accurately monitor internal temperatures.
findings.citation_text: 4-204.112(A) Temperature Measuring Devices. (A) In a mechanically refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, the sensor of a TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure the air temperature or a simulated product temperature in the warmest part of a mechanically refrigerated unit and in the coolest part of a hot FOOD storage unit. [C]

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment: Light was observed to be passing through the middle (left and right) and beneath the emergency exit door at the back storage. The PIC was advised to close the holes at the center of the door and to use weather stripping to tightly seal beneath the door. Ensure the gaps are sealed to prevent potential entry of pests.
findings.citation_text: 6-202.15(A) Outer Openings, Protected. (A) Except as specified in (B), (C), and (E) and under (D) of this section, outer openings of a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by: (1) Filling or closing holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings; (2) Closed, tight-fitting windows; and (3) Solid, self-closing, tight-fitting doors. [C]

findings.title: Hot and cold water available; adequate pressure.
findings.comment: The restroom handwashing sink was observed to have no hot water available. The PIC was informed. Ensure hot water is provided at the restroom handwashing sink at all times. The inspector will follow-up on March 26, 2026 to verify compliance.
findings.citation_text: 5-103.11(B) Capacity. (B) Hot water generation and distribution systems shall be sufficient to meet the peak hot water demands throughout the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT. [PF]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Bare wood and gaps were observed at the left side of the restroom door by the paper towel holder. The PIC was instructed by the inspector to ensure the bare wood is painted and the gaps closed for easy cleaning and to prevent possible hideout for pests.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. [C]

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: Inspector observed the bottoms of cold holding units containing milk to be soiled. Clean and maintain the bottoms of the coolers clean for the next routine inspection. 

NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: Inspector observed the floor in the restroom to have some missing tile behind the toilet and base cove that is pulling away from the wall in this same area. Repair these items and maintain in good repair for the next routine inspection. 

PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-202.15: (A) Outer openings of FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against entry of insects and rodents. (B) Does not apply to FOOD ESTABLISHMENTS which opens into larger structure. (C) Exterior doors need not be self-closing if designed for limited-use. (D) If opening present, opening shall be protected against rodent and insects. (E) Paragraph (D) not applicable when pests are absent.

Observed the exterior door in the back room to have visible gaps and light showing at base. Pest concern for access to building. Repair by next routine inspection.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-501.111: PREMISE shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. If present (A) Routinely inspect shipments of FOOD and supplies (B) Inspect PREMISE routinely (C) Using methods, such as trapping devices Pf (D) Eliminate harborage conditions. 

Multiple small flying insects are observed around the mop sink in the back of the facility. PIC is instructed to consult their pest control agency and to maintain the premise free of pests. Inspector will follow up.
